description: Votation - Votation avril 2023 - Pour ou contre les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris ? is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Démocratie, des Citoyen.ne.s et des Territoires - Ville de Paris. Résultats de la votation- Pour ou contre les trottinettes en libre-service à Paris ? du 2 avril 2023 par secteur administratif Le dimanche 2 avril 2023, la ville de Paris a organisé une consultation citoyenne sur l'avenir de l'usage de trottinettes en libre-service. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Citoyenneté. Its keywords are résultats, vote, trottinettes. The portal shows 2023-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
